name: wcg
label: Western Cape Government (navy)

provenance.source: shesha-house-design-standard.md section 1.2 role table, plus sections 3.1-3.5 for type, radius, spacing and elevation. Every colour here was spot-verified present in that document.
provenance.note: WCG SD Asset Management.html contains ZERO :root blocks, zero CSS custom properties and zero var() references — its CSS is hand-written literals, so these values are MEASURED from the shipped build rather than extracted from a declaration. It is also not a React app: it ships a custom dc-runtime using <x-dc>/<sc-for>/<sc-if> custom elements.
provenance.whyThisBrand: Chosen deliberately as the harder test. WCG is the same app as LandBank under a second brand and is byte-identical in structure, so any structural leak shows immediately. It also exercises three DELETED accent roles, lifted elevation, an odd-biased spacing grid, a tint status model, and no webfont.

semanticNote: sage, accentBlue and accentTeal are NULL, not recoloured — WCG deletes those roles outright. accentBlue is folded into primary. A consumer must treat a null role as absent and fall back to primary or ink, never substitute a colour of its own. #ffffff and #c0392b are identical across every brand and are hard-coded.

type.webfontNote: Zero @font-face declarations. LandBank self-hosts Inter across 28 @font-face rules; WCG uses the system stack outright.
type.tabularNumeralsNote: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, 26 occurrences. LandBank has zero.

microLabel.note: Weight 700 here versus 600 in the house kit — the one typographic role where the brands genuinely differ in weight, not just colour.

spacing.note: Measured from 1,479 padding/margin/gap literals. The most-used values are 14 (10.3%), 11 (9.0%), 8 (8.4%), 9 (8.0%) and 18 (8.0%) — an odd-biased grid that a 'multiples of 4' rule would reject wholesale.

elevation.shadowCardNote: WCG surfaces are LIFTED where the house kit's are flat. This is a philosophy switch, not a value swap, and it is why shadowCard is a token every surface consumes rather than a per-component decision.

chrome.navModelNote: A 232px collapsible labelled sidebar with 9 destinations, against the house kit's 56px icon rail with 21. This is app configuration, NOT a token — see the design standard section 5.3. Recorded here so a consumer can read it, never so a token file can change page anatomy.

statusModelNote: Background is tinted and text is dark, over a 3-value map — the inverse of the house kit's solid+white over 16 values. The two models are NOT interchangeable.

statusPill.fgNote: null because the tint model derives the foreground from the tone rather than using a fixed white.

referenceListRampNote: Only three tones are in evidence, and under the tint model these are BACKGROUND colours whose foregrounds are #1A3E6F, #b06f04 and #6b7280 respectively. Do not seed a Shesha reference list from these as if they were fills — refListStatus paints the item colour as the fill, which would produce a pale chip with pale text.
